details.detail: Sidewall panels and seams. Clean joints every second window, with no gaps or z-fighting (s01, s02, s04, s05). Plain satin with no linen weave. The colour is neutral white where the photos read warm off-white (lighting).

F/J short bowls. The shape, the pane placement in the lower bowl, the smooth sides and the LED pill under the opening match omaat_room24 and tt_window (s09, b_jClose, ra_jWin). The pill is a little small and thin. The bowl is neutral (lighting).

PY/Y full-height tubs and raised bezel. In win_front, tub aspect (w/h) is ~0.40, pane/tub height ~0.42 and pane centre at 0.54 of the tub. sp_py14 measures ~0.42, ~0.36 and 0.54. The hood ramp and horizontal dip now match the photo. Remaining: the dark band under the lip (0.55 against 0.85) and a faint light card on the tub floor.
Pane tunnel lining and seal. Unchanged and right: the grey tunnel ring reads as in tt_window (s09, ra_jWin).

Electric shades (b_jClose, b_jSheer, s05). Blackout is 0.67 of the wall with crisp pleats up close. The sheer is a bright translucent white. The blackout is slightly too neutral against omaat_room24's warm taupe. Diagonal moire remains on the 6th-7th windows of s05.

Manual PY/Y shades (s08, win_front, win_close). The half and stowed states read, and the grip rail shows. At aisle distance a half-drawn shade (~240) is almost the same tone as the bezel, so the states are hard to read. sp_py24 also has a near-white shade but a visible top-hood edge. No fully closed shade is in the s08 frame.

Dado, grilles and placards. In the studio renders (win_low, win_oblique) the slate dado has a slatted grille per window bay and white placards between them, as in py_37301. b_dadoY2 is framed too high: it shows the window and seat, not the dado, so the dado is not checkable in-cabin this round.
Floors. The Y carpet in ra_carpetY is (45,54,74), a right navy with fleck. The door bay is brown carpet and the walkway grey mottled vinyl (104,102,108), faintly cool, with L std 12.2.

Type A door surround and viewing window (s06, s07, b_doorWin, q21). The layout matches lalf_134: EXIT sign, the control panel high on the aft side, the arm-arc placard, an assist bar and the window beside the arrowhead. The window is too narrow (0.42 against ~0.50) and has a heavy dark seal where the photo has a bright cream rim and a shade tab.

issues.detail: Blackout pleat moire on far windows
issues.problem: The pleat stripe is per-row vertex colour (kf 0.62 on alternate rows of 62), so it cannot mip-filter and beats against the pixel grid beyond about 4 m.
issues.evidence: rb12/s05far.png: diagonal bands on the 6th-7th windows of s05.
issues.fix: 07_shell.js l.411 n 62 -> 40 (pleat ~9.5 mm; omaat_room24 shows ~40 pleats on the pane), l.425 kf 0.62 -> 0.70. Better: put the stripe in a mip-mapped detail layer on uv.v and drop the vertex stripe.

issues.detail: Door viewing window narrow, with a dark seal and no shade tab
issues.problem: Glass aspect 0.42 against ~0.50 in lalf_134. The photo has a bright cream rim and a slide tab at the top. Ours has a grey seal.
issues.evidence: rb12/doorwin.png against lalf_134 (window at ~245-320 x 510-655 in the 2000 px display).
issues.fix: 07_shell.js l.645 windowCellPattern(cellW, 0.20, 0.46, ...) -> (cellW, 0.23, 0.46, ...). Use the reveal cream MAT for the door-window seal instead of WMAT.seal, and add a 0.10 x 0.02 x 0.01 m cream tab box just inside the top edge of the glass.

issues.problem: The lip measures 0.55 of the pier against 0.85 in sp_py14. The hood ramp below it is right.

notes: w12 against w11. src/07_shell.js has had no commits since 220b46f, which predates the w11 ratings, so every change in these renders comes from lighting snapshots and neighbouring areas. The camera set is new, so I compared against the references by measurement, not pixel diffs with w11. No high or medium shell issues. Geometry checks pass: PY/Y tub aspect ~0.40 (sp_py14 ~0.42) and pane centre at 0.54 of the tub (0.54); F/J bowl and pill layout match omaat_room24 and tt_window; blackout 0.67 of the wall (photo ~0.69 of the bezel); hood ramp and horizontal dip within ~0.07 of sp_py14. What remains is all low: far-window pleat moire, the narrow door window with its dark seal, the dark lip band, a small pill, plain wall, slight hue offsets, and lighting-side neutrality.
